Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism

Record Class CubismRuntimeSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.CubismRuntimeSnapshot
Record Components:
project - the active project when it is available to the caller
document - the active document when it is available to the caller
model - the active model when it is available to the caller
selection - the selection captured with this observation
modelObjects - the immutable union of model object snapshots
parameters - the immutable parameter snapshots
artMeshes - the immutable ArtMesh snapshots
deformers - the immutable deformer snapshots
public record CubismRuntimeSnapshot(Optional<ProjectSnapshot> project, Optional<DocumentSnapshot> document, Optional<ModelSnapshot> model, SelectionSnapshot selection, List<ModelObjectSnapshot> modelObjects, List<ParameterSnapshot> parameters, List<ArtMeshSnapshot> artMeshes, List<DeformerSnapshot> deformers) extends Record
Immutable aggregate of a single Cubism runtime observation.

Collections are defensive immutable copies. The value neither owns host resources nor remains current after it is returned.
